## About

I’m a Tech Lead / AI-minded Senior Software Engineer who loves turning complex problems into scalable, elegant systems. I’ve led backend teams, defined software architecture for microservices at scale, and built strong testing/CI frameworks. I enjoy mentoring engineers, aligning stakeholders, and building software.

---

## Professional Experience

### Head of Backend & Data — tyba (2026 - present)

**Description:** Expanded scope to Head of Data, leading the data engineering function and owning the company’s data platform and pipeline infrastructure.

**Long description:** In this role, I design and lead the implementation of data architecture capabilities that unify business data, improve governance, and enable faster data-driven decisions across the organization.

**Responsibilities:**
- Defining data architecture standards for ingestion, storage, governance, and analytics consumption.
- Leading cross-team initiatives to align backend systems and data platforms with business priorities.
- Ensuring security and operational excellence across data pipelines and environments.

**Achievements:**
- Created data ingestion microservices to centralize heterogeneous sources into a single data lake while complying with technology and security standards.
- Migrated all data software artifacts into a monorepo architecture with CI/CD pipelines, multiple deployment environments, and infrastructure-as-code standards.
- Developed an AI agent that automatically writes SQL queries over the company data mart from natural language prompts, improving data accessibility for non-technical stakeholders.

### Head of Backend — tyba (2024 - present)

**Description:** Full time job leading a team of 26 engineers building a serverless microservice-based wealth-tech platform.

**Long description:** I lead <strong>26 engineers</strong> shipping a <strong>serverless</strong>, <strong>microservice-based investment platform</strong> on TypeScript, AWS, and GitHub Actions.

**Responsibilities:**
- Own backend <strong>architecture</strong> and internal tooling for better <strong>DX</strong>; keep the company’s <strong>9 squads</strong> aligned with priorities.
- Balance staffing across squads to protect delivery and deadlines.
- Champion <strong>mentorship</strong> and career growth for backend engineers.

**Achievements:**
- Rolled out company-wide <strong>AI architecture</strong>: <strong>centralized MCP gateway</strong>, internal/external tools and agents, secure discovery/auth, reusable skills—about <strong>50%</strong> higher developer productivity.
- Shipped a <strong>code review agent</strong> (<strong>human-in-the-loop</strong>, <strong>LLM-as-a-judge</strong>) trained on JIRA history, plus a <strong>TDD vibe-coding skill</strong> that writes code from specs and learns from senior PRs.
- Broadened <strong>testing strategy</strong>: <strong>stage testing</strong> on anonymized production data, first frontend <strong>E2E</strong> suite, in-memory <strong>SQS/SNS</strong> replicas for local/CI; standardized <strong>clean architecture</strong> for new microservices.

### Backend Tribe Lead — tyba (2023)

**Description:** Full time job supervising three backend development teams, overseeing their day-to-day activities, performance, and professional growth

**Long description:** In this role, I supervised <strong>three backend development teams</strong>, overseeing their day-to-day activities, performance, and professional growth.

**Responsibilities:**
- Making critical architectural decisions, ensuring alignment with industry best practices and long-term business goals.
- Strategically guiding the backend engineers of 3 software development squads to achieve project milestones.
- Coordinating cross-functional initiatives of the company with other teams to ensure coherence among the overall system.

**Achievements:**
- Designed a fault-resilience framework for company messaging queues using autonomous retries, exponential backoff policies, and dead-letter queues to protect critical flows and reduce incident impact.
- Refactored one of the company’s most critical microservices (KYC) to the new event-driven architecture I designed, decoupling services and introducing topic/queue-based communication with multiple external and internal transversal microservices.
- Designed and implemented a company-wide event-driven architecture standard, leveraging AWS SQS/SNS for messaging, Terraform for infrastructure as code, and a monorepo approach to streamline development workflows and ensure architectural consistency across backend services.

---

### Backend Squad Lead — tyba (2022 - 2023)

**Description:** Full time job leading a backend team responsible for maintaining the Peruvian version of tyba

**Long description:** In this role, I led a backend team responsible for maintaining the Peruvian version of tyba.

**Responsibilities:**
- Leading the design and development of technical solutions that address business requirements.
- Orchestrating cross-functional collaboration between business, operations, and development teams.
- Ensuring the correct operation of the Peruvian products by meticulously monitoring performance and addressing any issues that arise.
- Upholding a high standard of code quality through code reviews, best practices enforcement, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Achievements:**
- Created a company-wide rate-limiting utility for external API integrations, leveraging Redis as a low-latency state manager plus internal logical queues and locks to control throughput safely.
- Improved the SAGA pattern implementation by adding direct DB access in the orchestrator microservice, reducing orchestration latency and failure scenarios.
- Established the Peruvian version of tyba as the most profitable product in the company.

### Mid Backend Developer — tyba (2021 - 2022)

**Description:** Full time role as backend developer for a fintech platform used by thousands of users.

**Long description:** In this role, I designed and delivered core backend capabilities for mutual funds, portfolio operations, and customer communication features across the tyba platform.

**Responsibilities:**

**Achievements:**

- Designed a company-wide generic dashboard banner component to deliver key client communications; the implementation was robust enough to be used for 5+ years with zero core modifications.
